title: Flow-Corrected Thompson Sampling for Non-Stationary Contextual Bandits
abstract: arXiv:2606.23933v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We study non-stationary linear contextual bandits where the reward model drifts over time, rendering classical contextual bandit algorithms brittle because historical data becomes systematically biased. We propose Flow-Corrected Thompson Sampling (fcTS), a Bayesian method that reuses experience by transporting past rewards to the present using an explicit drift model and incorporating each transported observation with a confidence weight that reflects transport reliability. This yields a unified template that specializes in (i) linear parameter drift via online slope estimation and reward correction, (ii) periodic variation via phase-aware reuse across cycles, and (iii) recurring regime switches via changepoint detection and regime-specific posterior memory. translated_title: 面向非平稳上下文赌博机的流校正汤普森采样
translated_abstract: 我们研究奖励模型随时间漂移的非平稳线性上下文赌博机问题。由于历史数据会产生系统性偏差，经典的上下文赌博机算法在此类场景下变得脆弱。我们提出流校正汤普森采样，这是一种贝叶斯方法，通过显式漂移模型将过去的奖励传输到当前时刻来复用经验，并以反映传输可靠性的置信度权重纳入每个传输后的观测。由此得到一个统一的模板，可专门化用于：(i) 通过在线斜率估计和奖励校正处理线性参数漂移；(ii) 通过跨周期的相位感知复用处理周期性变化；(iii) 通过变点检测和状态特定的后验记忆处理反复出现的状态切换。在线性高斯模型下，所得的后验更新保持闭式形式，并可通过截断的、增量更新的充分统计量高效实现。
tldr: 提出流校正汤普森采样，通过显式漂移模型将历史奖励传输至当前并以置信度加权复用，为非平稳线性上下文赌博机中的线性漂移、周期变化和状态切换提供了统一的闭式后验更新框架。
en_tdlr: Proposes Flow-Corrected Thompson Sampling (fcTS), which transports past rewards to the present via an explicit drift model with confidence weighting, providing a unified closed-form Bayesian framework for non-stationary linear contextual bandits handling linear drift, periodic variation, and regime switches.
